title: IT - OIT - Network Technician
description:
Job Title: Network Operations Support Technician
Project Location: Montgomery, AL

Position Overview:
The Network Operations Support Technician performs full-performance level technical work in monitoring, maintaining, and supporting data communication systems within the Client's LAN/WAN environment. This position plays a key role in ensuring network availability, performance, and reliability across statewide multi-complex networks encompassing point-to-point, wireless, campus, VPN, and agency host configurations for both voice and data circuits. The role requires an analytical, service-oriented professional capable of responding promptly to network events, coordinating issue resolution, and maintaining accurate documentation in enterprise systems such as ServiceNow.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Monitor network alarms, alerts, and system faults using network management tools and dashboards.
  • Promptly respond to events to ensure service reliability and minimal downtime.
  • Perform initial triage, analysis, and escalation for network-related incidents.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of incidents, service requests, problems, configuration items, and change activities in ServiceNow.
  • Generate and analyse reports from network management systems, databases, and spreadsheets to identify performance trends or hardware/service issues.
  • Create and manage trouble tickets; coordinate with technical support, field engineers, and maintenance teams for resolution.
  • Provide Tier 1–2 level troubleshooting for LAN/WAN connectivity and voice/data circuit issues.
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams and external agencies to ensure transparent issue handling and resolution updates.
  • Support a rotating shift schedule, including weekends and holidays, as part of 24x7 operations coverage.
  • Adhere to established network operations procedures and security standards.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience supporting or maintaining LAN/WAN environments.
  • Minimum 1 year of call center or service desk experience handling technical incidents.
  • Working knowledge of network monitoring tools, IP addressing, VPNs, routers, and switches.
  • Experience with incident ticketing systems such as ServiceNow or Remedy.
  • Understanding of voice and data circuit troubleshooting processes.
  • Strong customer service, communication, and documentation skills.
Education:
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Associate's degree or technical diploma in Information Technology, Networking, or Telecommunications preferred.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • CompTIA Network+ Certification (strongly preferred).
  • Familiarity with state government IT environments or large-scale enterprise networks.
